rules.statement: A tooltip never carries the only copy of a label or an instruction; if the value matters, it is in the interface, visible and copyable.
The tooltip appears on keyboard focus as well as hover, dismisses on Escape without moving focus, and on touch it appears on tap with a second tap outside to dismiss.
The trigger references the tooltip with aria-describedby (not aria-labelledby) so the accessible name stays the control's own label and the hint is announced after it.
The tooltip sits 8 px from the trigger, flips and shifts to stay inside the viewport, never covers the trigger, and does not follow the pointer.
Interactive content, formatted paragraphs and anything a reader must select is a popover or a dialog, because a hover tooltip cannot be reached on touch.
